test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

My friend did not steal my money.

options.text: My friend was not stolen by my money.
My money has not been stolen by my friend.
My money is stolen by my friend.
My money was not stolen by my friend.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is "My friend did not steal my money", and it is in the **simple past tense.**
 
• The proper structure for passive voice in the simple past is: **subject + 'was/were' + past participle.** In this case, the verb** 'steal' **has the same form for both the base and past participle.
 
• When we rephrase this active sentence into passive voice it becomes: "My money was not stolen by my friend."

Therefore, the correct answer is - **Option 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Options 1 and 3 present incorrect structures of the sentence. 
 
• In option 1, the order of objects is upside down, making it semantically incorrect. 
 
• In option 3, the sentence uses **"is"**, which suggest present tense and does not match the tense of the original sentence.
 
• Option 2 employs an incorrect tense as it uses** "has"** suggesting present perfect, which does not match the simple past tense of the original sentence.
